code:
$ ls /var/log
syslog   auth.log   dpkg.log   nginx/
kern.log cron.log   apt/       mysql/

$ tail -f /var/log/syslog
caption: /var/log/syslog (or /var/log/messages on RHEL) is the first stop when something breaks.
